about: Lithicarb (lithium) 250 mg, two tablets at night, is supplied every month for nine months and appears by brand name only.
Quilonum SR (lithium carbonate) 450 mg every 12 hours (900 mg daily) is supplied four times from December 2025 to March 2026, in the middle of a 15-month history.
Lamictal (lamotrigine, a mood stabiliser that is not lithium) is supplied every month. No lithium is supplied.
